serverInfo.title: Agent402
serverInfo.description: Agent402 is the payment and trust layer for agentic commerce: agents find, pay for and verify every paid call to Agent402, across x402 and MPP, with a signed receipt for each one. 500+ ready tools on the same rails. Flagships: live web search and cited answers, news, browser render, market data, speech-to-text and wallet-keyed memory; the rest via catalog.find. Settle in USDC via x402 or MPP (Machine Payments Protocol) on the same 402, or free via proof-of-work. The applied layer of Agentic Finance. Maintained by Havok Holdings LLC.
